  ],
  "shapeMode": "rounded",

  "recipeIdsUsed": ["destructive-confirmation"],
  "accessibilityFacts": [
    "Dialog must remain the confirmation surface — do not substitute Toast/Alert for a modal decision.",
    "Keep a clear action hierarchy in the footer: dismiss/cancel vs danger confirm.",
    "Prefer restoring focus to the invoking control via finalFocusRef when that control remains in the page.",
    "Do not rely on color alone for the destructive meaning — Button danger variant plus clear action text.",
    "Dialog traps focus while open, supports Escape-to-close, role=\"dialog\" with aria-modal=\"true\", and returns focus to the trigger or finalFocusRef on close."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Dialog is implemented in Skrewww but not installable via the @skrewww registry; Button is installable with npx shadcn add @skrewww/button.",
    "Package manager is unknown (empty lockfile); Shape=rounded and Surface=glass are confirmed from layout data attributes."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Dialog has no installCommand / installableViaSkrewwwRegistry is false — must obtain Dialog implementation outside shadcn @skrewww install."
  ],
  "implementation": "Controlled Dialog with open/onOpenChange and closeOnOverlayClick={false}. DialogBody holds consequence copy (heading/text as ordinary children). DialogFooter holds Cancel (Button variant=\"secondary\") and Delete (Button variant=\"danger\"). Optionally wire finalFocusRef to the trigger. Preserve document shape=rounded and surface=glass. Install Button via registry; do not invent a Dialog install command."
}
